  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The skip covers only CHANGES_LOST_REDISPATCHED `true` and `skipped_peer_inflight`, so retry-unavailable runs (`false`, `skipped_budget_unavailable_or_exhausted`, unset or push-disabled) still send a report from a run that ends `success`, and the intake rejects it as `not_failed`.
  WHY: The intake accepts only `failure` and `timed_out` conclusions (workflow_failure_heal.py:277, 4381-4387), so the false "heal rejected run provenance" WARNING is not fully eliminated, and the push-disabled path posts only a Telegram WARNING with no PR comment (review_autofix.yml:5266-5274). Severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT (confidence 3), the other three MAJOR, and the highest is used.

  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The skip condition checks only the two env flags and not the job status, so a run that redispatched successfully but whose job later fails (reporter fires on `failure()` at review_autofix.yml:5913) is silently not reported.
  WHY: Before this PR such a run was reported, though no concrete failing later step was found, so the trigger is not demonstrated.

  WHY: The repository's custom instructions exceed the size limit, so the check would fail on any PR here; no hunk in this diff causes it. Confidence is 5 per anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, which cited CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash cited review_autofix.yml with confidence 3.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:198-202 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `changes_lost_retrying` skip covers only `true` and `skipped_peer_inflight`. Retry-unavailable runs, including the `CAN_PUSH=true` retry-unavailable run and the push-disabled run, still send a report but also end `success`.
  WHY: The intake (workflow_failure_heal.py 4381-4387) accepts a run only while `in_progress`, `queued` or `pending`, or when it concluded `failure` or `timed_out`. The same race remains, so the false WARNING is reduced but not eliminated. The PR rationale "the run posts a failure comment" does not hold for push-disabled.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:198-202 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The skip is keyed only on the two flag values, not on job status. A later failure after a successful redispatch would be dropped.
  WHY: Before this PR such a run was reported. No concrete later failing step was found.
- CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md (external check run, no changed line implicated) | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The external check fails because the custom instructions are too large.
  WHY: The check cannot build its prompt. It is not fixable within this PR's scope.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh lines 198-202. Pass `job.status` into the reporter env and add `&& [ "${REPORT_JOB_STATUS:-success}" != "failure" ]` to the skip condition (about 2 lines, optional, low value). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:198-202 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fix only skips reporting for `true` and `skipped_peer_inflight`. Other outcomes (`false`, `skipped_budget_unavailable_or_exhausted`, or unset) that also end green still trigger the false "heal rejected run provenance" WARNING.
  WHY: The heal reporter keeps sending reports for runs that end in `success`, so the intake rejects them with the same provenance warning.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:198-202 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Retry-unavailable editor-loss reports can still be rejected as `not_failed`. The push-disabled path sends a Telegram warning but posts no PR failure comment, and posting a failure comment does not make the reporting run conclude `failure` or `timed_out`. Supporting paths: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5266-5274, 5913; scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:277, 4381-4383.
  WHY: If the intake checks the run after it completes successfully, provenance rejects it because only `failure` and `timed_out` are reportable. The report then has no verified runs and triggers the same warning this change is meant to prevent.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 0
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:193-202 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The skip suppresses the false page only for `true` and `skipped_peer_inflight`. Retry-unavailable cases still report: `skipped_budget_unavailable_or_exhausted`, `false` when every dispatch candidate fails, and the push-disabled case where the variable is unset. None fail the job, so the run ends `success` and the intake rejects it with `reason=not_failed`. Supporting paths: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5232-5275 and scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:277, 4381-4387.
  WHY: Every retry-unavailable editor_changes_lost run still emits a report from a green run, which pages "Workflow failure heal rejected run provenance ... reason no_verified_runs", the incident (PR #8718, run 41564230342) this PR claims to eliminate. The README, agents.d fragment and changelog wrongly treat "still reported" as safe.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:198-202 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The reporter fires on `failure() || env.EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST == 'true'` (review_autofix.yml:5913). A run with `CHANGES_LOST_REDISPATCHED=true` whose job later fails reaches the new skip and is dropped, because the condition checks only the env flags.
  WHY: A genuinely failed run with lost-then-retried editor changes can no longer produce a heal report. The suggested fix is to pass `REPORT_JOB_STATUS: ${{ job.status }}` into the reporter env and gate the skip on it.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (external check-run `copilot-pull-request-reviewer`, run 41765722687; no changed hunk implicated) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `copilot-pull-request-reviewer` check failed with `custom_instructions_too_large` ("Prompt too big after adding system message", statusCode 422).
  WHY: The repository's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md payload exceeds the size limit. It would fail identically on any PR here, and no code fix belongs in this PR.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, reporter step env block, lines 5915-5928. Add `REPORT_JOB_STATUS: ${{ job.status }}` and gate the skip on it in the reporter (2 lines total). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
